messages:
sam: FYI getting 403s on SAML login after KMS rotation. JIT users are being created but assigned no roles. Audit entries show `encryption_tag=null` for a bunch of events. Anyone else seeing this?
megan: same here, started around 2026-03-19T03:12Z when the KMS key rotation kicked off. authz service returning 500s for decrypt calls.
kai: paste of relevant logs: ```
2026-03-19T03:12:18Z authz ERROR decrypt failed key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd1234 error=InvalidCiphertextException
2026-03-19T03:12:18Z sso WARN missing attribute: x-redwood-kms-tag
2026-03-19T03:12:19Z jit INFO created user uid=U12345 but role=viewer (policy fallback)
```
megan: also noticed PR 1b2f3a (PR#4567) toggled `sso.require_kms_tag = true` in prod config. That change landed ~03:10Z.
irena: that was the infra change to enforce an explicit kms-tag before doing role mapping. The intention was to prevent ambiguous key selection during rotation, but it looks like it caused mapping to early-fail when the assertion lacked the tag.
ops: rolled back the config toggle at 03:40Z (deploy 2026-03-19T03:40Z). We also restarted authz and the decrypt error rate dropped. Partial recovery: some users regained roles, but ~120 accounts still stuck with viewer.
sam: we need to backfill roles and fix audit gaps — some audit records have null encryption metadata so we can't correlate which key was used. That hurts forensic trace.
megan: short-term mitigation: add a retry/timeout bump on KMS decrypt and record the decrypt error reason into the audit entry. Long-term: we should stop requiring decrypt during the synchronous role mapping path and instead enqueue an async verify job that updates roles after a session is created.
kai: suggested change: fall back to previous key mapping when decrypt fails due to rotation, and avoid failing the whole mapping call. Also, move heavy KMS ops off the hot path (async).
irena: agree. Also add a mapping table (kms-tag -> key-version) and a tolerance window for rotation TTL so tags aren't strictly required at the moment of assertion.
ops: created incident INC-2026-0320 and triggered the oncall. Runbook snippet we followed: ```
- rollback policy toggle to previous value
- restart authz service (graceful)
- run `scripts/reconcile_sso.py --since 2026-03-19T03:00Z` to reconcile roles
- backfill audit logs with decrypt failure reasons
```
kai: can we implement an immediate hotfix to accept missing tag and try legacy lookup? That would reduce the delta.
irena: ops already applied a permissive hotfix in prod — it accepts missing `x-redwood-kms-tag` and attempts legacy lookup. Deploy note: reverted the strict config and introduced `sso.kms_fallback=true`.
sam: action items consolidated: 1) ops: hotfix to tolerate missing tag (done) 2) megan: backfill audit + validate CloudTrail/KMS history (RED-812) 3) kai: design async role-mapping PR (RED-813) 4) irena: own postmortem and remediation timeline (RED-814).
security-bot: Incident INC-2026-0320 created by irena. Severity: medium. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0320
megan: I added the Jira tickets and assigned owners. Will run the backfill tonight and report success in the morning. :white_check_mark:
sam: quick SOC note — please audit for any privilege drift during the window 2026-03-19T03:10Z..2026-03-19T03:40Z, especially around admin-scoped roles. :eyes:
ops: monitoring alerts cleared at 04:20Z. Reconcile job currently processing ~120 accounts, ETA ~2h.
megan: will push a small audit-schema change to include `decrypt_error` and `kms_key_id` fields so future events are traceable.
irena: we should schedule a key-rotation dry-run in staging with the new fallback logic before next rotation.
sam: thanks all. I'll kick off the SOC checklist and join postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:
